target: 事实描述 / 作者价值判断
skill: 事实描述 ≠ 作者价值判断
q: A report says that residents posted hundreds of angry comments after the council announced a parking plan. Which conclusion is directly supported?
o: The plan deserved every angry comment it received.
The announcement triggered substantial negative reaction.
The council knowingly designed a harmful plan.

exp.trans: 一份报告说，市议会公布停车方案后，居民发布了数百条愤怒评论。原文直接支持的是：该公告引发了大量负面反应。
exp.structure: 主句：A report（主语）+ says（谓语）+ that宾语从句。that从句：residents（主语）+ posted（谓语）+ hundreds of angry comments（宾语）；after从句只交代时间。句子报告发生了什么，没有评价这些评论是否应得。
exp.other: council 市议会；announce 公布；substantial 大量的/显著的；reaction 反应。
exp.meaning: 阅读中有人批评或指控，只能直接证明存在负面反应，不能自动推出作者赞同这些批评或认为对象活该。
exp.rest: deserved every angry comment加入作者价值判断和绝对化every；knowingly designed a harmful plan推测动机；All residents把数百条评论扩大成所有居民。

target: 标题覆盖全文 / 局部主题
q: 短文先介绍图书馆除纸质借阅外的电子书、设备借用和线上课程，随后重点讨论线上课程的版权风险。哪个标题最能覆盖全文？
o: Beyond Printed Books: New Library Services
The Only Safe Way to Teach Online

exp.trans: 文章先介绍图书馆在纸质书借阅之外提供的多种新服务，后文再重点讨论其中线上课程的版权风险。最合适的标题应覆盖多种新服务这一全文框架，而不是只概括后半部分。
exp.structure: 题干给出总框架到其中一项风险的篇章结构。标题需要同时解释前半部分为什么介绍多个服务，也能容纳后半部分的版权讨论。
exp.other: printed book 纸质书；device lending 设备借用；copyright 版权；cover 覆盖。
exp.meaning: 标题题要找能统摄全文的上位概念。局部篇幅很长，也不能因此把局部主题当成全文主题。
exp.rest: Copyright Problems in Online Courses只覆盖后半篇；Why E-books Will Replace Libraries加入取代主张；The Only Safe Way含Only且主题过窄。

q: The city's hydrogen-bus program is still in its infancy: only five vehicles are operating and the charging network is incomplete. Here, in its infancy means:

exp.trans: 这座城市的氢能公交项目仍处于起步阶段：目前只有五辆车在运营，补能网络也尚不完整。
exp.structure: 主句：The city's hydrogen-bus program（主语）+ is（系动词）+ still in its infancy（表语）。冒号后的only five vehicles和network is incomplete具体解释为什么说它还处于早期。
exp.other: hydrogen 氢能；vehicle 车辆；operate 运营；incomplete 不完整的。
exp.meaning: be in its infancy是固定比喻表达，表示某项技术、行业或计划尚处于早期、起步阶段。
exp.rest: decline是衰退；fully mature与only five和incomplete矛盾；infancy在此不是字面婴儿期。

q: A company created a cheerful hashtag for a launch, but angry customers soon filled it with complaints. The campaign effectively became hostage to the users. This means:
o: the users physically detained the marketing staff
the campaign came under the users' control and was turned against the company
the company paid users to promote the campaign
the campaign was legally transferred to another firm

exp.trans: 公司为新品发布创建了一个轻松的话题标签，但愤怒顾客很快用投诉占满了它。这个营销活动实际上受到了用户挟制，也就是传播控制权被用户夺走并反过来对公司不利。
exp.structure: 第一句but连接预期与反转。第二句：The campaign（主语）+ became（系动词）+ hostage to the users（表语）。这里hostage是比喻，不是实际绑架。
exp.other: hashtag 话题标签；launch 发布；complaint 投诉；turn sth against sb 使某物反过来对某人不利。
exp.meaning: become hostage to表示受……控制或挟制；传播语境里的hijack也常表示夺走原本的传播控制权。
exp.rest: physically detained是字面绑架；paid users是付费推广；legally transferred是法律转让，都没有体现用户利用原活动反向施压。

q: Users can choose to receive e-mail alerts whenever the price of a saved product falls. Here, alerts means:

exp.trans: 用户可以选择在已收藏商品降价时接收电子邮件提醒。
exp.structure: Users（主语）+ can choose（谓语）+ to receive e-mail alerts（不定式内容）；whenever从句说明提醒在什么条件下触发。
exp.other: saved product 收藏的商品；price falls 价格下降；receive 接收；whenever 每当。
exp.meaning: alert作名词可表示提醒、警报或通知；e-mail alert就是邮件提醒。
exp.rest: receipt才是付款凭证；ad blocker是广告屏蔽工具；complaint record是投诉记录。

q: Airlines, hotels, and rail companies are all travel providers. In this phrase, travel mainly tells us:
o: the providers are physically moving while working
the field or service category the providers belong to
the providers only sell travel books
travel is the main verb of the sentence

exp.trans: 航空公司、酒店和铁路公司都属于旅游或出行服务提供商。这里travel说明providers所属的服务领域。
exp.structure: Airlines, hotels, and rail companies（并列主语）+ are（系动词）+ travel providers（表语）。travel在travel providers中是名词作定语，修饰providers。
exp.other: airline 航空公司；rail company 铁路公司；provider 提供商；category 类别。
exp.meaning: 英语中名词可修饰名词，travel provider表示提供旅游或出行相关服务的机构，不必把travel翻成独立动作。
exp.rest: physically moving把travel误当动作；books无依据；travel在该短语中不是谓语动词。

q: Printers and ink cartridges are often described as ___ products because each increases the usefulness of the other.

exp.trans: 打印机和墨盒常被称为互补产品，因为两者会提高彼此的使用价值。
exp.structure: Printers and ink cartridges（并列主语）+ are described（被动谓语）+ as complementary products（补足说明）。because从句解释为什么是互补关系。
exp.other: ink cartridge 墨盒；usefulness 实用价值；describe A as B 把A描述为B；competitive 竞争性的。
exp.meaning: complementary表示互补的、相辅相成的。注意complimentary多表示免费的或赞美的。
exp.rest: complimentary可指免费赠送的或赞美的；competitive表示相互竞争；temporary表示临时的。
